title: l3lint configuration (.l3lint.yaml)
description: Team defaults so CI and laptops lint the same way. Unknown keys are errors. Relative paths resolve from the folder that holds the file.

context.description: Defaults used when the payload and the command line are silent.

brand.description: Card brand used when the payload has no card.brand and --brand is not given. all lints every transaction against every brand; auto uses only the payload.

cardProduct.description: Card product used when the payload has no card.product and --card-product is not given.

mcc.description: Merchant category code used when the payload has no merchant.mcc and --mcc is not given.

merchantCountry.description: Merchant country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) used when the payload has no merchant.country and --merchant-country is not given.

processor.description: Profile name, or a path to a profile YAML file. --processor overrides it.

strictProfiles.description: Run single-processor rules at their catalog severity under every profile, as --strict-profiles does.

format.description: Input format. auto detects it from the payload. --format overrides it.

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency for payloads that carry none, such as Braintree requests (ADR-0056).

csvMap.description: Column map for CSV input, relative to this file's folder. --map overrides it.

limits.description: Hard input limits. An input over a limit is an input error (exit code 2); the other inputs are still linted.

maxFileBytes.description: Largest input in bytes (25 MB by default). For .ndjson and .jsonl files the limit applies to each record.

maxLineItems.description: Most line items one transaction may carry.

rules.description: Which rules run, their severities and the data quality settings.

only.description: Run only these rules (IDs or globs such as VISA-DQ-*). --only replaces this list.

disable.description: Rules to skip (IDs or globs). --disable adds to this list.

severity.description: Severity per rule ID or glob, for example GEN-DQ-007: error. A --severity flag for the same key wins.

placeholders.description: Edits to the placeholder description list that GEN-DQ-001 and VISA-DQ-001 use.

add.description: Terms to treat as placeholder descriptions, in addition to the shipped list.

remove.description: Shipped terms to stop treating as placeholder descriptions.

batch.description: Thresholds for the batch rule GEN-DQ-007.

minTransactions.description: Fewest transactions in one run before GEN-DQ-007 is checked.

sameValueShare.description: Share of the run's transactions that must carry the same description or product code for GEN-DQ-007 to fire.

arithmetic.description: Tolerance and rounding for the arithmetic rules.

lineTolerance.description: Largest accepted difference between a reported and an expected line total, in major units. Default: 1 minor unit of the transaction currency (0.01 for USD).

totalTolerance.description: Largest accepted difference for the transaction total and the header tax, in major units. Default: 1 minor unit of the transaction currency.

toleranceMode.description: strict uses totalTolerance as given. accumulated uses the larger of totalTolerance and 1 minor unit per line, capped at 5 minor units.

rounding.description: How a midpoint rounds when quantity times unit cost is rounded to the currency exponent.

strict.description: Stop instead of masking when a card number is found, as --strict-pci does.

allowFields.description: Canonical JSON Pointers (* matches any line index) exempt from card-number detection. Add a path only after a person confirms its values are not card numbers.

output.description: Default outputs and the failing threshold.

failOn.description: Lowest severity that sets exit code 1. --fail-on overrides it.

formats.description: Outputs to write, each kind or kind=path, for example sarif=artifacts/l3lint.sarif. Paths resolve from this file's folder. Any --output flag replaces the whole list.

maxFindings.description: Most findings to print. The summary still counts every finding. No limit when absent.

rates.description: Rate table YAML for cost estimates, relative to this file's folder. --rates overrides it.
